description: This file implements the EnvVariableParser class, which manages environment variable-based configuration for logging levels, console logging, and file logging in the Rialto project. It includes functions to parse environment variables, determine logging levels, and initialize logging settings.

classes.name: EnvVariableParser
classes.description: Manages environment variable-based configuration for logging levels, console logging, and file logging in the Rialto project.

methods.name: EnvVariableParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes debug levels, console logging flag, and log file path, then configures logging based on environment variables.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the debug level for a specified component.

methods.name: isConsoleLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether console logging is enabled.

methods.name: isFileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether file logging is enabled.
